camel_example: aliyun qualitycheck RunCompletionMessage --region cn-hangzhou --Messages '[{"Role":"user","Content":"请用50字总结一下对话"}]' --ModelCode TYXM_PLUS --Stream true --version 2019-01-15 --method POST --force
description_en: This operation calls a large model using the message protocol to generate a response. You can make calls using standard HTTP for a complete response or use Server-Sent Events (SSE) for a streaming response
description_zh: 支持以Message协议格式调用大模型获取分析结果，接口调用支持 HTTP 调用来完成客户的响应，目前提供普通 HTTP 和 HTTP SSE 两种协议，您可根据自己的需求自行选择
kebab_example: aliyun qualitycheck run-completion-message --model-code TYXM_PLUS --messages Role=user Content=请用50字总结一下对话 --stream true --api-version 2019-01-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunCompletionMessage

parameters.help_en: The model specification to use. Valid values: `TYXM_PLUS` and `TYXM_TURBO`
parameters.name: model_code

fields.help_en: The role of the message sender. Valid values: `user`, `agent`, `system`, and `function`
fields.help_zh: user-客户 agent-客服 system-系统消息 function-函数
fields.name: role

parameters.help_en: A list of messages that form the conversation history and the current prompt
parameters.help_zh: 模型请求 Message 列表
parameters.name: messages

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to stream the response using Server-Sent Events (SSE). If `true`, the response is streamed. Defaults to `false`
parameters.help_zh: true 则会开启 SSE 响应，默认 false
parameters.name: stream

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of `200` indicates success

FinishReason.description_en: The reason the model stopped generating output. For streaming responses, this value is `null` until the final message. It is set to `stop` if generation ended because a stop token was reached
FinishReason.description_zh: 如果是流式输出，正在生成时为null，生成结束时如果由于停止token导致则为stop

LlmRequestId.description_en: The request ID from the large model

Text.description_en: The text output generated by the large model
Text.example: 这段对话似乎是客服与客户之间关于一个服务或产品的讨论，但具体内容难以明确理解，因为对话中的言语比较零散和抽象。

Message.description_en: The error message if the request fails. This field returns successful if the request succeeds
Message.description_zh: 出错时表示出错详情，成功时为successful

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request succeeded. A value of true or null indicates success, while false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功，调用方可根据此字段来判断请求是否成功：false表示失败，true/nul表示成功
